scope: Lens Studio Preview, not physical glasses footage.
All hands are actual scripted SIK inputs, not composited illustrations.
The real-size display is a supplied model placed on a measured indoor patch; no room recognition.
The aligned model rechecks both tasks; conservative additional reserve is about 1.506 mm for the chair route, not 3 cm.
The close chair image is optional detail; the wide corner image supplies wardrobe and floor-boundary context.
